key_points: Ford's EV sales plunged ~80% YoY in Q3 2026, raising concerns about its EV transition.
An analyst downgrade on Oct 7 pushed the stock down 1.3%.
A Micron‑Ford memory pact announced Oct 7 sparked a short‑term rally in the stock.
Ford shares rose ~1% on Oct 6 on broader market outperformance.
Overall news flow mixes negative fundamentals with modest positive catalysts.
